<thought>Based on the available spectral data, the most plausible structure is an N‑acetyl‑anisidine (N‑acetyl‑4‑methoxyaniline), whose SMILES string is “CC(=O)Nc1ccc(OC)cc1”. This matches the observed carbonyl (~166 ppm), aromatic carbons, a methoxy group (~52 ppm), and the aliphatic carbons of the acetyl moiety.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)Nc1ccc(OC)cc1</final_answer>
